name: Quantum algorithms
blurb: Speedups, and the classical work that keeps taking them back.

touchstones.text: quantum algorithms with provable speedup, query and gate complexity bounds
Hamiltonian simulation algorithms: product formulas, qubitization, signal processing
quantum linear algebra, block encodings and singular value transformation
variational algorithms: VQE, QAOA, and their optimization landscapes
end-to-end resource estimates for chemistry, optimization and cryptanalysis
dequantization and classical algorithms that match quantum claims
sampling-based quantum advantage and its classical spoofing
